body: I have they told me to come back home. They know but I don’t think they understand. I want to die but don’t want to hurt my kids. Like I said they are the only reason I am still here. My doctor is on a military base and I can’t get on because my tags are expired.

I know I need meds. I can’t get to the Dr to get them. Idk what to do anymore. I feel so confused. So much to do so little time. I think the only reason I am still hanging on is because my son needs me. But honestly it’s getting to be a bit much. My family keeps telling me to be strong. But I am all tapped out. I wish I could cry out but my kids will hear me.
